title: Basic calculator
test_suite:
import io, sys

def test_prints_114():
    _old = sys.stdout
    captured = io.StringIO()
    sys.stdout = captured
    exec(open("exercise.py").read())
    sys.stdout = _old
    output = captured.getvalue()
    assert output == '114\n', f"Expected 114, got {output!r}"
